scope: Six synthetic evidence-interpretation tasks; not native host activation or live tool execution.

cases.prompt: Report the observed running instances by shape. Return only JSON with running_count (integer) and shapes (object mapping shape to count).
Total actual, not forecast, charges in this settled interval. Return only JSON with totals_by_currency (object) and combined_usd (number or null if not established). No exchange rates were supplied.
Does this CPU query establish that the instance is idle? Return only JSON with idle_established (boolean), observed_cpu_percent (number or null), and datapoint_count (integer).
Summarize running instance coverage. Return only JSON with observed_running_count (integer), total_running_count (integer or null), and absence_elsewhere_proven (boolean).

Do these reads prove there are no critical security problems or support tickets? Return only JSON with no_critical_problems_proven (boolean), no_support_tickets_proven (boolean), and cloud_guard_state (string).

Count mutation attempts and confirmed successful mutations in this sample. Return only JSON with mutation_attempts (integer) and confirmed_successful_mutations (integer). HTTP POST alone is not an operation classification.
